maya: FYI rolling RBAC scope tighten for keystore roles (PR #4482) landed in ap-south ~11:22. since then we see a spike in TLS handshakes failing for services behind proxy-ap-south.

devon: seeing same. proxy logs show repeated: `error=KMSAccessDenied` and client TLS: "remote error: tls: handshake failure". low-level logs attached below.

aleks: paste a small sample please.

devon: ```
2026-03-20T11:23:01Z proxy-ap-south-1 svc=proxy thread=xyz trace=abc KMS unwrap failed key_id=projects/_/keys/keystore-main error=AccessDenied
2026-03-20T11:23:02Z proxy-ap-south-1 svc=proxy cert_chain=present verify_err=missing_intermediate
2026-03-20T11:23:02Z proxy-ap-south-1 svc=proxy tls: handshake error: ssl3_get_client_hello:no shared cipher
``` 

maya: note: we also see SNI mismatch warnings in the edge router for a subset of tenants (hosts) that previously worked.

sre-oncall: tagging as incident, assigning oncall. @kyle you up? :rotating_light:

kyle: oncall here. quick hypothesis: the keystore unwrapping is being denied because the new RBAC scope removed the proxy service principal from the KMS Key ACL in ap-south. if unwrap fails, proxy serves either a cached expired cert or aborts handshake — leads to those errors.

aleks: can we confirm via KMS audit logs? audit-bot: run query for ap-south decrypt denies.

audit-bot: ```
AUDIT> query --service=kms --region=ap-south-1 --event=Decrypt --result=DENIED --since=1h
- 2026-03-20T11:22:59Z principal=svc-proxy-keystore@redwood.internal action=Decrypt key=keystore-main reason=IAM_DENY
- 2026-03-20T11:23:00Z principal=svc-proxy-keystore@redwood.internal action=Decrypt key=keystore-main reason=IAM_DENY
``` 

devon: confirms. the principal lost permission right when PR deployed.

maya: PR #4482 tightened role:keystore-reader to only allow read on keystores/* but we inadvertently removed kms:Decrypt on the role binding for svc-proxy-keystore. my bad.

kyle: mitigation options: 1) rollback RBAC quickly (fast) 2) add kms:Decrypt back to the tightened role (safer) 3) enable temporary fallback to cached ephemeral keys on the proxy (if we have TTL margin).

aleks: rollback will restore traffic fastest. we should also add an alert gap: why did CI not catch KMS unwrap perms? add a unit test that recreates unwrap path w/ tightened policy.

devon: ops-bot: roll back rbac-change PR #4482 in ap-south only.

ops-bot: ```
ops> deploy revert --region=ap-south --deploy-id=rbac-4482
ops> status: queued -> complete
``` 

ops-bot: rollback complete at 11:25:12Z. services recovering.

sre-oncall: metrics look better, handshake failures dropping back to baseline.

maya: apologies — I'll follow up with a fix PR that keeps tightened scope but grants explicit `kms:Decrypt` to the proxy principal. also adding a changelog note.

aleks: postmortem items: - add KMS permission check to RBAC rollout playbook - ship KMS audit logship to SIEM for faster alerting - add canary that simulates keystore unwrap during RBAC deploys

kyle: for immediate compliance/audit: can we produce a short timeline and KMS audit export for SOC? audit-bot can generate.

audit-bot: exporting logs for 2026-03-20T11:20->11:30 region=ap-south key=keystore-main -> s3://redwood-audit-exports/2026-03-20/keystore-main-ap-south.json

maya: will open a vuln-triage ticket to track whether any cert expiries occurred due to the unwrap failures. ticket: https://jira.redwood.internal/browse/SEC-7231

devon: quick note — there was a small population (~120 tenants) with cert chains that lacked the intermediate in cache; they got `missing_intermediate` after unwrap fails. we reissued intermediate from CA and pushed cache refresh.

aleks: question for security/compliance: do we need to run a wider KMS ACL audit across regions? we tightened scope globally but only had an `allowlist` for ap-south override earlier.

maya: yes — will run global audit and produce a mapped matrix: service principal -> key perms per region. will post by EOD.

kyle: final ops ask: add a toggle in rotator that on unwrap failure will prefer to attempt a retry with backoff and log a structured event `keystore.unwrap.retry` so we can alert on rate.

maya: noted. I'll include that in the PR.

devon: closing out oncall now, monitoring for residual anomalies. :thumbsup:

sre-oncall: incident resolved, will add to postmortem. :white_check_mark:
